title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can edit and run playbooks on a container label could…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permissions to edit and run playbooks on a container label can associate a custom-function callback with another playbook run. This flaw allows the callback to modify the state of a container beyond the user's authorized scope due to improper binding of playbook API requests to the trusted playbook run and container context.
